body_markdown:
## Introduction


Your organic search traffic is no longer just about the blue links.[15% of all website traffic now originates from AI agents and bots](https://otterly.ai/blog/best-ai-search-monitoring-and-llm-monitoring-solutions/) , with ChatGPT alone driving 56% of that referral stream. If you are still relying solely on traditional SEO dashboards, you are flying blind in a channel that now represents a double-digit percentage of your total discovery.


This shift has birthed Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), a discipline focused on how brands appear inside AI-generated answers on platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Standard rank trackers cannot tell you if a large language model describes your product as "outdated" while recommending a competitor. Otterly.ai has been a pioneer in this space, monitoring all seven major AI search engines, but it is not the only option.


For marketing teams evaluating their tech stack in 2026, the landscape of GEO platforms has matured into distinct tiers. Whether you are optimizing a Shopify store, defending enterprise brand equity, or trying to figure out why your referral traffic looks different this quarter, you need a tool that measures mention rates, citation quality, and share of voice inside probabilistic text. This article compares the leading Otterly AI alternatives to help you lock in visibility before the channel gets more crowded.


## Key Takeaways


The GEO tool landscape in 2026 splits cleanly between self-service platforms built for agility and enterprise suites that prioritize depth and benchmarking.


- **The traffic shift is material:** 15% of all website traffic now comes from AI agents and bots, making AI visibility tracking a non-negotiable part of the marketing stack.
- **Siftly is the pragmatic default:** With multi-engine coverage across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews, plus a free audit with no sign-up, it balances technical depth with operational ease for small to mid-size teams.
- **Semrush Enterprise AIO targets the sentiment gap:** Its core value is competitive intelligence and brand sentiment analysis inside AI-generated answers, fitting naturally into existing enterprise SEO workflows.
- **Profound plays at the top of the market:** Backed by a[$180M Series D](https://ayzeo.com/comparisons/peec-ai-vs-profound) and counting Target, Walmart, and Ramp as customers, it is the benchmarking engine of choice for large organizations with custom procurement.
- **Manual tracking is a dead end:** The volume and velocity of AI citations across multiple engines make spreadsheets impractical; automated monitoring is the only viable way to surface trends and anomalies at scale.


## Verdict: Siftly vs. the Competition at a Glance


For most marketing teams stepping into GEO, Siftly is the most direct and accessible replacement for Otterly.ai. It tracks brand visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews, layers on conversion tracking for AI-referred traffic, and offers a free trial that does not require a credit card.


The decision branches once you factor in organizational scale and analytical depth. Small to mid-size teams and ecommerce operators get the highest signal-to-noise ratio from Siftly because it connects directly to a Shopify store, tracking how AI models describe products and measuring downstream conversions. The platform provides multi-engine citation monitoring and prescriptive optimization recommendations without the bloat of a traditional enterprise suite.


Larger organizations with dedicated competitive intelligence groups should look beyond self-service tools. Semrush Enterprise AIO layers brand sentiment tracking into its existing keyword ecosystem, giving an enterprise SEO team a unified view of organic and generative performance. At the very top of the market, accounts like Target and Walmart run Profound for its benchmarking depth, panel-derived prompt volume data, and API access, but the enterprise-only pricing and opaque implementation make it overkill for a team just trying to establish baseline AI visibility.

## How Siftly Tracks AI Visibility Across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity


Siftly operates as a dedicated GEO platform that monitors how AI models describe a brand, surfaces misrepresentations, and attributes downstream traffic back to specific citations.


1. **Establish multi-engine monitoring:** Siftly queries the live consumer interfaces of ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity,[and Google AI Overviews](https://llmpulse.ai/blog/best-siftly-alternatives) daily, measuring visibility, rank, and share of voice across all four surfaces.
2. **Track citation quality and context placement:** The platform identifies how a brand appears in the answer, flagging cases where the AI misrepresents a product attribute or omits a key differentiator.
3. **Attribute AI-referred traffic to specific citations:** Siftly connects referral traffic directly to LLM citations, measuring conversion events tied to AI-referred clicks rather than treating AI traffic as an anonymous aggregate channel.
4. **Generate prescriptive optimization recommendations:** Based on citation patterns and content performance, the tool identifies which question formats and content types produce the strongest citation frequency for specific industries and topics.
5. **Integrate with publishing and commerce infrastructure:** Connects directly to Shopify to track product-level AI visibility and attribution, while also integrating with WordPress, Webflow, Search Console, and Slack to fold GEO data into existing workflows.


## Profound: Enterprise AI Visibility with a Focus on Benchmarking


Profound occupies the top tier of the AI visibility market, backed by a[$180](https://ayzeo.com/comparisons/peec-ai-vs-profound) M Series D from Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, and Lightspeed and serving enterprise accounts including Target, Walmart, and Ramp.


Its analytical architecture differs fundamentally from self-service GEO tools. While most platforms report absolute citation metrics for a single brand, Profound offers panel-derived prompt volume data, a feature reserved for its Enterprise tier that allows brands to size the addressable opportunity within AI answer real estate across an industry. With this dataset, an analyst can benchmark whether their brand occupies the share of voice proportional to its market position and spot where competitors are over-indexing.


The company has built what outside reviewers describe as the deepest execution stack in the GEO category, but depth comes with friction. The API, most multi-engine coverage, and the prompt volume data sit behind a custom Enterprise tier requiring a procurement motion. There is no transparent pricing page, and the onboarding process is not self-serve, making Profound a poor fit for teams that need to spin up AI visibility tracking in a week with a credit card.


For the right buyer, a Fortune 500 brand manager who needs to report AI citation benchmarking to a CMO alongside traditional share-of-voice metrics, Profound is the category reference point. For everyone else, the complexity and opaque pricing make it a heavyweight solution to a problem that lighter tools solve with 90% of the insight at a fraction of the operational overhead.


## Semrush Enterprise AIO: Sentiment and Competitive Intelligence in AI Answers


Semrush Enterprise AIO extends the company's search intelligence into generative answers,[monitoring brand visibility in AI-generated content](https://searchengineland.com/library/ai-seo/generative-engine-optimization/page/3) with an emphasis on sentiment and competitive benchmarking. It is the natural gravitation point for large marketing organizations already running their organic strategy on Semrush.


The module's core differentiation is sentiment analysis at scale. Rather than simply logging whether a brand was cited, Semrush Enterprise AIO evaluates the framing, tracking everything from brand sentiment to how competitors are performing inside AI answers. For an enterprise brand manager, that distinction matters. A neutral citation that describes the brand accurately and a negative citation that misrepresents a service line are two different problems, requiring two different responses. Semrush surfaces that nuance and layers it into a competitive intelligence framework that the existing user base already understands.


The trade-off is scope. The module focuses on brand sentiment and competitor data inside AI-generated content, rather than the broad multi-engine, multi-content-format tracking that dedicated GEO platforms prioritize. For an enterprise team that needs a unified view of organic and generative performance, that tight integration with the Semrush ecosystem is a feature, not a bug. But a mid-market team looking for standalone AI visibility tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews will find it narrower than purpose-built alternatives.


## Which AI Visibility Tracker Should You Choose?


Match the tool to your organizational reality, not to a feature matrix. The right platform is the one your team will actually log into weekly, interpret correctly, and act on.


If you run a small to mid-size marketing team or an ecommerce operation on Shopify, start with Siftly. The platform covers the core AI engines, tracks visibility and downstream conversions, and lets you begin monitoring with a free tool that requires no sign-up. The Starter plan at[$79](https://llmpulse.ai/blog/best-siftly-alternatives) per month is calibrated for teams tracking a small product catalog, while Growth at $249 scales product and prompt coverage as you expand.


Enterprise SEO teams already embedded in the Semrush ecosystem should activate their Enterprise AIO module. The sentiment tracking and competitive benchmarking slots directly into dashboards your team already uses, reducing implementation friction. Evaluate it through the available 14-day trial to validate that the AI-specific metrics surface insights your standard rank tracking reports miss.


For Fortune 500 brands where AI benchmarking must stand alongside traditional brand health metrics in a board presentation, initiate the Profound enterprise evaluation process. Do this only if your team has the analytical staffing to absorb its depth and the procurement bandwidth for a custom contract. If you simply need to know how ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity describe your brand today, lighter tools get you there faster.


## Conclusion


AI search has matured past the experimental phase. With[15%](https://otterly.ai/blog/best-ai-search-monitoring-and-llm-monitoring-solutions/) of traffic now flowing through agents and bots, the window to establish baseline visibility and start optimizing before the landscape saturates is closing. Siftly remains the most practical otterly.ai alternative for teams that want to move from zero to visibility intelligence without navigating enterprise procurement. Getting monitoring in place now means building the citation footprint that will determine share of voice as the channel expands through 2026 and beyond.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What is a GEO platform, and how does it differ from traditional SEO tools?


A Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform monitors how a brand appears inside AI-generated answers from tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity. Traditional SEO tools track keyword rankings in blue-link results; GEO platforms measure mention rates, citation quality, sentiment, and share of voice within AI's single summarized answers.


### Which platforms besides Siftly help track how brands appear in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews?


Multiple platforms address this need. Semrush Enterprise AIO tracks brand visibility, sentiment, and competitor performance[in AI-generated content](https://searchengineland.com/library/ai-seo/generative-engine-optimization/page/3) . Profound offers enterprise-grade benchmarking with panel-derived prompt volume data. Otterly.ai monitors all seven[major AI search engines](https://otterly.ai/blog/best-ai-search-monitoring-and-llm-monitoring-solutions/) and provides real citation positions by querying the actual user interfaces.


### How do AI visibility monitoring tools measure metrics like mention rates, citation quality, sentiment, and share of voice?


These tools query AI platforms with defined prompts and analyze the generated responses. Mention rate tracks the frequency a brand appears across queries; citation quality evaluates the context and framing. Sentiment analysis classifies whether the AI describes a brand positively or negatively, while share of voice compares a brand's citation frequency against competitors in the same answer space.


### What features should marketing teams look for when comparing tools for ongoing AI brand visibility tracking and competitive benchmarking?


Prioritize multi-engine coverage that includes ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews at a minimum. Look for citation quality analysis, not just mention counting, plus sentiment tracking to surface misrepresentations. Competitive benchmarking against industry peers and conversion attribution for AI-referred traffic separate reporting tools from platforms that drive actionable optimization decisions.


### What are the key differences in capabilities and pricing between Siftly and its main competitors for small teams vs. enterprise clients?


Siftly offers self-service plans starting with a Free tier, then Starter at $79/mo, Growth at $249/mo, and Scale at $599/mo, with a free trial and no-credit-card audit. Profound serves enterprise accounts like Target and Walmart with custom pricing gated behind a procurement motion. Semrush Enterprise AIO operates as an add-on module for existing Semrush enterprise subscribers.


### Are there any free tools or free trials available for checking a brand’s current visibility in AI search results?


Yes. Siftly offers an AI Visibility Checker that runs a free audit with no sign-up required. It also provides a 14-day free trial that does not require a credit card upfront. The free audit queries ChatGPT and Claude with industry-relevant buyer questions to give a directional snapshot of current AI brand visibility.
